learning_outcomes.text: Describes of basic properties of acoustics and noise.
Learns the methods used for analysis of noise which is an indispensable phenomenon in physical systems.
Learns of adverse effects caused by noise and importance of its control in mechanical systems.
Learns the techniques used in control or reduction of noise levels.
Has awareness of the environmental effects of noise.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION: A brief history of acoustics, importance of the study of acoustic, basic concepts of acoustics, the acoustic field variables.
BASIC CONCEPTS: Units, spectra, wave, combining sound pressure levels, hearing, brief description of the ear.
NOISE MEASUREMENT: Microphones, weighting networks, sound level meters, grades of the sound level meters, calibration, sound measurement.
ACOUSTIC PLANE WAVES: Elastic behavior of fluids, plane wave equation, harmonic solution of the plane wave equation, energy density of plane waves.
ACOUSTIC PLANE WAVES: Acoustic intensity, specific acoustic impedance, acoustic standards and reference conditions, decibel scales.
TRANSMISSION PHENOMENA: Changes in media, transmission from one field medium to another: normal incidence, reflection at the surface of a solid.
TRANSMISSION PHENOMENA: Transmission through three media: normal incidence, transmission loss for solid wall materials.
OBLIQUE TRANSMISSION: Transmission from one fluid medium to another: oblique incidence, reflection at the surface of a solid: oblique incidence.
NOISE REDUCTION: Sound transmission trough partitions, composite transmission loss, a case study.
NOISE REDUCTION: Enclosures, barriers, pipe wrappings, a case study.
Week ENVIRONMENTAL NOISE: Calculation and estimation of environmental effects of transportation noise (road traffic, railway traffic and airline noise).
NOISE CONTROL ENGINEERING: A general quick review of industrial applications, law related to noise.
bibliography: D.A. Bies, C.H. Hansen, Engineering Noise Control, 4th edn., CRC, 2009.
B.J. Smith, R.J. Peters, S. Owen, Acoustics and Noise Control, Longman, U.K, 1982
